FUXI_GOD_BLESSING.Name: Yin and Yang (God Blessing)
FUXI_GOD_BLESSING.LR:
Fuxi grants alternating bonuses, which swap every 4 minutes:
• Yin: Peasants and Kuafus gather +10% faster.
• Yang: Human soldiers and siege weapons +10% damage.

NUWA_GOD_BLESSING.Name: Creator’s Auspice (God Blessing)
NUWA_GOD_BLESSING.LR: Nüwa reduces Peasant cost and improves building hitpoints as you earn Favor.

SHENNONG_GOD_BLESSING.Name: Gift of Beasts (God Blessing)
SHENNONG_GOD_BLESSING.LR: Shennong summons myth units from the next Age at your Temple for free as you earn Favor.
